text: Fire and gas detection shall be in the SIS with the mapping of the fire and gas detector study (ALP-EPC-00000-HS-STU-0003): voting 2oo3 for the executive actions, low alarm at 10 %, high alarm at 20 % and executive action at 40 % of the lower explosive limit for methane and hydrogen (as HS-DBR-0001 section 10); ammonia, chlorine and other toxic gases per the HAZOP results; detectors are certified for the zone (ER-14.06) and for the marine atmosphere.
